thread:
Priya: quick pattern check for the past quarter. I ran an automated recurrence scan and got 5 repeat vectors. posting short summary + suggested owners so we can open tracked tickets.

IncBot: Recurrence scan complete - 29 incidents in 90d. Clusters: pool-saturation, config-drift, warmup-lapse, external-throttle, deploy-metadata-misses. Report: https://infra/reports/recurrence-q1-2026-brief

Jun: can you list counts per cluster? helps triage.

Priya: counts: pool-saturation 11, config-drift 6, warmup-lapse 5, external-throttle 4, deploy-metadata-misses 3.

Marta: I'll take deploy-metadata-misses. Plan: add a CI schema linter for deploy metadata and a post-deploy verifier. ETA 2w.

Ravi: I'll own pool-saturation fixes. Short-term: add 10% pool margin during scheduled model swaps; long-term: adjust autoscaler smoothing window and add KV-cache reuse improvements. Short fix ETA 10 days.

Jun: config-drift I can handle. Proposal: periodic config-diff job + pre-merge linter for pool tags. ETA 3w.

Priya: warmup-lapse I'll take. Implement gauge-triggered warmup and a lightweight prefetch step to populate caches. ETA 3 wks.

Priya: proposed actions I'll open as tracked tickets with owners:
- ACTION-RP-1: Pool margin + autoscaler tweak. Owner: Ravi. ETA: 2026-04-14.
- ACTION-RP-2: Config-drift detection + linter. Owner: Jun. ETA: 2026-04-20.
- ACTION-RP-3: Warmup gauge + prefetch. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-04-28.
- ACTION-RP-4: Deploy metadata linter + verifier. Owner: Marta. ETA: 2026-04-05.
- ACTION-RP-5: External throttle strategy (retries + circuit breaker). Owner: Priya (product to sign off). ETA: 2026-04-10.

IncBot: Reminder: ACTIONs without an owner after 48h will escalate to oncall.

Marta: adding that each ticket should include a "recurrence_reason" field (enum: capacity-surge, template-bug, warmup-gap, external-flaky, config-drift).

Ravi: I'll prototype pool-margin change and run a small load test tomorrow; will post results in this thread.

Jun: will start the config-diff job skeleton and share a PR next week.

Priya: scheduling a 30m follow-up in 7 days to review PRs and blockers. Calendar invite to follow. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
